source_snapshot.items: Check ECC memory after rocHPL performane test
source_snapshot.procedure: Run a performance test for 24 hours, then issue OEM IPMI raw 0x06 0x52 0x01 0xac 0x02 0xef 0x1a and collect post-test logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Replaces the OEM raw query with rocm-smi ECC counters and does not preserve the stated 24-hour/raw-command coverage.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires duration decision, workload/config, raw field schema and absolute-versus-delta ECC oracle.

old_problem: The Procedure mandates 24 hours while Machine Time says 10 minutes; the OEM raw response field/endian meaning and whether zero is absolute or a zero-new-error delta are unspecified.
disposition_reason: ED-14 forbids replacing the formal 24-hour stress with the 10-minute metadata, but the source conflict still requires an owner decision. ED-03 also forbids guessing the OEM raw response schema. A parameterized IP/workload cannot repair the missing duration and ECC semantics, so review remains pending.
decision_basis: Directly read all 18 Compatibility row238 XLSX cells, same-row DeepSeek/GPT review and history2841.
Preserved the 24-hour rocHPL intent and exact raw bytes; did not substitute rocm-smi or expose source credentials.
Required before/after ECC deltas, ROCm/SEL corroboration and recovery; no workload or IPMI command was executed.

test_case.test_name: 24-hour rocHPL followed by OEM ECC-memory verification
test_case.purpose: Stress the approved AMD GPU set with the project rocHPL profile for the authoritative duration, then prove whether any new ECC memory error occurred using the defined OEM raw field and independent counters.
required_package: Owner decision that 24 hours governs or an explicit revised duration
Pinned rocHPL/ROCm build, matrix/profile, GPU mapping and thermal/power limits
Vendor definition of raw 06/52 response offset, length, endian and counter meaning
Secure BMC endpoint/credential binding, baseline/delta oracle and SEL/ROCm correlation
test_case.test_command: Do not run until duration and raw schema are signed. Capture baseline GPU/BMC ECC counters and health; run the approved rocHPL workload continuously for the approved duration; stop on health abort; query the exact approved OEM raw field with secrets supplied at runtime; capture post counters, SEL and logs; compute the signed absolute/delta rule.
test_case.expected_result: The full authorized rocHPL interval completes without health abort and the decoded OEM ECC field plus corroborating ROCm/BMC evidence meet the approved zero-error rule.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is prohibited until duration and raw decoding are approved. A 10-minute smoke run, exit zero, undecoded byte 00, or rocm-smi alone cannot satisfy the source case.
safety_gate: Dedicated thermally qualified SUT and explicit long-stress authorization
Never embed fixed credentials; verify target controller and GPU map
Monitor temperature, power, ECC/XID, kernel and SEL with hard aborts
Preserve evidence and do not automatically retry a failed/aborted 24-hour run
expected_evidence: Baseline, periodic and final health/ECC telemetry
Raw request/response with decoded field schema plus ROCm/SEL correlation
Duration proof, abort status, recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop rocHPL on any limit or error, preserve all partial evidence, return temporary clocks/services to baseline and verify GPU/BMC/OS health. Any rerun requires new authorization.

source_conflict.reason: The authoritative 24-hour Procedure and 10-minute Machine Time remain irreconcilable without owner authority.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete; execution cannot start until duration and OEM ECC semantics are supplied.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Approve duration, rocHPL profile/GPU map, OEM raw response schema, zero absolute-versus-delta rule and health/recovery limits.
pending.owner: AMD GPU performance, BMC/OEM and project test-plan owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Signed duration plus vendor raw-field and ECC acceptance contract.

project_authority: The OEM raw command and project duration/threshold are not defined by generic IPMI or ROCm documentation.
